meta.title: A bid from a subsidiary of an existing bidder is refused
gaps: The plan cannot explicitly verify the subsidiary relationship or identify which existing bidder belongs to the same subsidiary network.

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event with two QA vendors invited, each with a submitted bid; bidding still open.
steps: The invited QA vendor sends the bid call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “A bid has already been placed by your team”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: A bid from a subsidiary of an existing bidder is refused
